products.description:
Retinol is an essential ingredient in any anti-aging skincare routine. A retinol serum is an effective product for improving the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, skin texture and radiance.When looking for a face serum to add to your skincare routine, look for ingredients like ceramides that help restore and protect your skin barrier. It may take some time for your skin to adapt to retinol, so plan to slowly work your way up to daily use to avoid skin irritation. To help your skin look and feel its best, look for a face serum formulated with hydrating and calming ingredients like hyaluronic acid and niacinamide.

CeraVe Skin Renewing Retinol Serum is a gentle, yet effective daily retinol serum that provides your skin with a variety of anti-aging benefits. Our retinol face serum is formulated with ingredients like hyaluronic acid for extra hydration, niacinamide to soothe, and three essential ceramides that work together to lock in moisture and help restore your skin’s protective barrier. It’s also formulated with MVE Technology that encapsulates ceramides to ensure efficient delivery within your skin’s barrier and slow release over time, supporting your protective skin barrier long after you’ve finished applying.

Moisturizer and sunscreen are two essential steps in any skincare routine for healthy-looking skin. To help keep things simple, you can use a facial moisturizer that includes broad-spectrum SPF 30 sunscreen, like our AM Facial Moisturizing Lotion. Facial moisturizers with sunscreen allow you to hydrate your skin and help protect it from the sun’s rays in one convenient step. However, sunscreens must be reapplied at least every two hours for sunscreen protection.

CeraVe AM Facial Moisturizer is a morning skincare multitasker that moisturizes and nourishes your skin while helping to absorb and reflect the sun’s damaging UVA and UVB rays. It’s formulated with three essential ceramides, along with hydrating hyaluronic acid, soothing niacinamide, InVisibleZinc™ Technology (microfine zinc oxide), and our MVE technology—which releases a steady stream of moisturizing ingredients for continuous, all-day hydration.

products.description:
Product Description
The Skin Labo all-in-one gel is a versatile skincare product that offers UV protection and contains three moisturizing ingredients. It provides a fresh feeling upon application and delivers ample moisture deep into the stratum corneum. This product is particularly recommended for skin care during hot weather. After washing your face, this single product can be used as a "toner", "essence", "milky lotion", "cream", "pack", and even as a "makeup base" + "UV blocker". It also finishes off makeup beautifully. It is fragrance-free, colorant-free, mineral oil-free, and gentle on the skin.

Product Specification
Brand Name: Skin Labo
Product Name: Hada Labo Kyokujun UV White Gel
Weight: 90g
Manufacturer: Rohto Seiyaku

Usage and Cautions
Use with caution to avoid any skin problems. If you notice redness, swelling, itching, irritation, color loss (e.g., vitiligo), or darkening during or after use due to exposure to sunlight, discontinue use and consult a skin doctor or other specialist. Symptoms may worsen if use is continued. Do not use on areas with scars, rashes, eczema, or other skin problems. If it gets into eyes, rinse immediately with water or lukewarm water. If irritation persists, consult an ophthalmologist. After use, be sure to close the cap and use the product as soon as possible. Avoid high or low temperatures and direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of infants. Do not store in a place with high or low temperatures or in direct sunlight. If it should get on clothes, wash with detergent immediately and carefully.

products.name: INNBEAUTY Project Slushy
products.overview: A lightweight serum moisturizer with hyaluronic acid & bakuchiol to visibly plump, hydrate, smooth texture & boost glowing, healthy-looking skin.
products.description:
For hydrated, Smooth & Poreless looking skin. A unique texture with all the benefits of a serum & moisturizer, in one.
This moisturizer/ serum hybrid instantly hydrates skin like a tall glass of water.
Bakuchiol (plant based retinol) is spun at high speeds into a hyaluronic acid serum creating a slushy-like texture. This texture provides skin with the benefits of a serum and a moisturizer, in one. The hyaluronic acid quickly hydrates while bakuchiol helps smooth & clarify the look of skin. while keeping breakouts at bay and smoothing the look of lines and wrinkles.
SUSTAINABLE PACK! This is the world's first fully curb-side recyclable pump bottle. It has no metal spring, which means you can toss it in the recycling bin when you're done.
 

BakuchiolKnown as a plant-based retinol alternative helps refine pores, smooth the look of fine lines, uneven texture & calms the look of breakout prone skin. 

Hyaluronic Acida super hydrator, holds 1000x it’s weight in water. Plumps skin for a dewy, gorgeous bounce. 

Yuzu high in vitamin C & anti-oxidant properties, brightens the look of skin.

Apply 2-3 pumps on clean skin, after toning. Massage and let absorb into the skin. SLUSHY can be used as a serum, moisturizer or both. For extra-dry skin you can layer SLUSHY under the NEXT LEVEL moisturizer. 
When to use: You can use SLUSHY in the morning and evening. 
SLUSHY hacks:
1) Keep it in the fridge for extra cooling & refreshing benefits.
2) Mix your favorite foundation with 1-2 pumps of SLUSHY to create the perfect, silky tinted moisturizer. Your skin will look hydrated, dewy & plump with a hint of coverage - perfect for summer.

Green Woods & Grapefruit Fragrance
A bold, long-lasting scent blends crisp green woods with bright notes of grapefruit, bergamot, pine, and sandalwood for an energizing, masculine all-day freshness.
Suave is Cruelty Free 
Globally, Suave is cruelty-free and never tested on animals, delivering performance-driven grooming you can feel confident about every day.

The combination of Bean Essence and Bean Cream offers deep nourishment and intensive hydration, delivering a powerful skincare experience. The essence uses concentrated fermented soybeans to deeply penetrate the skin, while the cream locks in moisture, ensuring a soft, plump, and hydrated complexion. Together, they improve skin texture by gently exfoliating and smoothing rough patches, leaving the skin feeling refreshed and even. Key ingredients like barley, pomegranate, pear, and soybean extracts work in synergy to hydrate, brighten, and protect the skin, promoting elasticity and a youthful glow. This dual-action system not only provides long-lasting moisture but also strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier, leaving your complexion radiant, smooth, and rejuvenated all day.

This set includes:

1 X mixsoon Bean Essence 50ml
1 X mixsoon Bean Cream 50ml

Ingredients

Bean Essence No.1 : Water/Aqua, Propanediol, Glycerin, Lactobacillus/Soybean Ferment Extract, Lactobacillus/Punica Granatum Fruit Ferment Extract, Saccharomyces/Barley Seed Ferment Filtrate, Lactobacillus/Pear Juice Ferment Filtrate

Bean Cream: Water/Aqua, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polyglyceryl-3 Distearate, Hydrogenated Coco-Glycerides, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Butylene Glycol, Diisostearyl Malate, Vinyl Dimethicone, Cetearyl Alcohol, Stearic Acid, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Glyceryl Stearate, Hydroxyacetophenone, Sorbitan Isostearate, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Carbomer, Tromethamine, Panthenol, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Propanediol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Adenosine, Melia Azadirachta Flower Extract, Eclipta Prostrata Extract, Coccinia Indica Fruit Extract, Disodium EDTA, Sodium Polyacrylate, Ocimum Sanctum Leaf Extract, Melia Azadirachta Leaf Extract, Curcuma Longa (Turmeric) Root Extract, Corallina Officinalis Extract, Lactobacillus/Pear Juice Ferment Filtrate, Saccharomyces/Barley Seed Ferment Filtrate, Lactobacillus/Punica Granatum Fruit Ferment Extract, Lactobacillus/Soybean Ferment Extract, Palmitic Acid, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Oil, Oleic Acid, Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil, Anthemis Nobilis Flower Oil

How to Use

After cleansing and toning, dispense a few pumps of Bean Essence and apply evenly over the face. Gently pat until fully absorbed. Follow with Bean Cream to lock in moisture and deliver long-lasting hydration for a smooth, glowing finish.

products.description:
OVERVIEW 
 
 
 Deep Vitamin C Capsule Serum
Brightening Vitamin C Serum for Dull & Uneven-Looking Skin with Visible Concerns
 
 
 Formulated with 99% high-purity Vitamin C to help revive the look of tired, dull skin and support a more vibrant-looking complexion.
Encapsulated Vitamin C melt-in capsules dissolve on contact to help deliver the formula evenly for smoother, refined-looking skin.
Infused with Hyaluronic Acid, Tocopherol, and Glutathione to help replenish moisture and support hydrated, healthy-looking skin.
Features a lightweight, fast-absorbing texture that melts smoothly into the skin without leaving a sticky or greasy residue.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 KEY INGREDIENTS 
 
 
 
 99% high-purity Vitamin C
 
 Helps revive the look of dull skin and supports a more vibrant, energized complexion
 
 
 
 5% Niacinamide
 
 Supports the appearance of a more balanced skin tone
 
 
 
 77% Hippophae Rhamnoides Water
 
 Helps refresh the skin and promote a healthy-looking glow
 
 *The information above pertains only to the characters of the raw materials

 
 Full Ingredients
 
 
 

 
 
 CLINICAL TEST
 
 Visible Improvement
 Revives dull and tired-looking skin: +4.15%↑
 
 Boosts skin’s natural glow: +31.78%↑
 
 ✔️Low-irritation formula suitable for all skin types 
 
✔️Melt-in capsule serum absorbs smoothly into the skin 
 
✔️Liposome capsules help maintain Vitamin C freshness

 *Clinically Tested by 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences' / Results may vary depending on individual skin types.
 
 

 
 
 HOW TO USE
 
 
 STEP1
Vitamin C liposome capsules absorb quickly into the skin, melting seamlessly to deliver refreshing care
 
 
 STEP2
Hippophae Rhamnoides Water and Niacinamide help refresh tired-looking skin, supporting a more energized and healthy-looking complexion
 
 
 STEP3
Hyaluronic Acid, Tocopherol, and Glutathione replenish moisture, finishing with skin that looks hydrated and radiant
 

 
 

 FAQ 

Q. What are the main benefits of the Deep Vitamin C Capsule Serum? It provides concentrated Vitamin C care to help improve the appearance of dull, uneven-looking skin while supporting smoother texture, hydration, and a healthy-looking glow.

Q. What are the capsules in the serum? The visible capsules contain concentrated Vitamin C and are designed to melt into the skin during application, providing even and effective daily Vitamin C care.

Q. Do I need to break the capsules before applying the serum? No. Simply apply and gently massage the serum into the skin. The melt-in capsules are designed to dissolve naturally during application.

Q. Does this serum help with dull skin? Yes. Vitamin C, Sea Buckthorn Water, and Niacinamide help revitalize tired, dull-looking skin for a clearer, more radiant-looking complexion.

Q. Can I use this serum every day? Yes. The gentle formula is designed for daily use. If you're new to Vitamin C, start gradually and increase usage based on your skin's tolerance.

Q. Who is this serum best for? It's ideal for skin concerned with dullness, uneven skin tone, rough texture, dryness, or lack of radiance, especially for those looking for lightweight daily Vitamin C care.

products.description:
OVERVIEW 

EGF NAD+ Firming Serum
Powered by next-generation ingredients including NAD+ and EGF to improve the appearance of wrinkles, firmness, and radiance for smoother, youthful-looking skin. Helps improve the appearance of wrinkles and skin firmness across key areas including forehead, eye area, smile lines and neck. Formulated with EGF peptide, NAD+, and Collagen to help nourish and revitalize the look of skin, and to help enhance skin's natural vitality. Targets fine lines & appearance of wrinkle, loss of skin firmness & elasticity, rough texture, dull skin tone.

CLINICALLY PROVEN

• Non-Comedogenic Tested*
• Primary Skin Irritation Tested*
• Free from Artificial Colorants
**Clinically Tested by 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences'/ Results may vary depending on individual skin types./li>

 CLINICAL TEST

One Drop Full the Lines

Visible Smile Lines*: 8.7%↓
Visible Neck Lines*: 5.38%↓

Boost & Restore Radiance

Forehead** (2.9%) / Eye Area** (2.2 %) / Corner of Mouth** (2.49%) / Cheek** (2.9 %)

*Smoother Looking Skin After 2 Weeks / Clinically Tested by 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences'/ Results may vary depending on individual skin types. **Clinically Tested by 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences'/ Results may vary depending on individual skin types.

 HOW TO USE 

Easy to Use
Apply 2–3 drops evenly onto face & neck

AM & PM Care
Use morning and evening as part of your skincare routine.

 FAQ 

What skin concerns is this serum designed for?This serum helps improve the appearance of wrinkles, loss of firmness, enlarged-looking pores, uneven texture, and dull-looking skin. It is formulated for both the face and neck.

Can I use this serum every day?Yes. The lightweight formula is suitable for daily use. Apply morning and evening after cleansing and before your moisturizer.

Can I use this on my neck?Yes. The serum is specifically formulated for both the face and neck. Apply 2–3 drops evenly across both areas as part of your daily skincare routine.

Can I use this with the AGE-R Booster Pro or Booster Mini?Yes. Apply the serum before using your Booster Pro X2 or Booster Mini. The devices can help support the absorption of your skincare as part of your routine.

Is this serum suitable for oily or acne-prone skin?Yes. The formula is non-comedogenic and dermatologist-tested, making it suitable for oily, combination, and troubled-looking skin.

Can I use this with Vitamin C or Retinol?Yes. The serum can be incorporated into most skincare routines. If you're introducing highly active ingredients such as retinol or exfoliating acids for the first time, consider adding products gradually based on your skin's tolerance.

At what age should I start using this serum?This serum is suitable for anyone beginning to notice visible signs of aging, such as fine lines, loss of firmness, or reduced skin elasticity, or for those looking to support healthier-looking skin before these concerns become more noticeable.

products.description:
OVERVIEW 
 
 
 Kojic Acid Turmeric Eye Gel Serum
 All-Day Brightening & Depuffing Eye Care with Retinol & Caffeine
 
 
 Helps target puffiness, dark circles, and dullness at once with a fast-absorbing gel serum that smooths, firms, and brightens the look of the delicate eye area.
 Powered by Kojic Acid, Turmeric, and Vitamin C, this brightening blend helps improve the look of dull and uneven under-eye tone.
 Formulated with Caffeine and Retinol to support firmer-looking skin and help reduce the appearance of puffiness.
 Features a lightweight, non-sticky gel texture that hugs every corner of the eye area for a smooth, comfortable finish.
 
 
 
 

 
 
 KEY INGREDIENTS 
 
 
 
 
 Kojic Acid, Turmeric, Vitamin C
 
 Brighten the look of dull, uneven under-eye tone for a more radiant look.
 

 
 
 
 Retinol & Caffeine
 
 Help reduce the look of puffiness and support a firmer, lifted-looking appearance.
 

 
 
 
 Hyaluronic Acid & Panthenol
 
 Deliver hydration and a cooling sensation for refreshed under-eyes.
 

 
 *The information above pertains only to the characters of the raw materials
 

 
 Full Ingredients
 
 
 

 
 
 CLINICAL TEST
 
 Leave The Bags Behind

 The appearance of eye puffiness was reduced by 4.62% after 1 use
 The appearance of under-eye bags was reduced by 13.09% after 2 weeks
 Visible dark circles improved by 2.70% after 2 weeks of use

 

 
 *Clinically Tested by 'Global Institute of Dermatological Sciences'/ Results may vary depending on individual skin types
 
 
 

 
 
 HOW TO USE 
 
 
 When?
 Use morning and night for best results
 

 
 How?
 Apply evenly to the under-eye area and gently pat until fully absorbed
 

 
 Pair?
 Use it with Booster Pro for a visibly plumper, brighter under eye
 
 
 

 
 
 FAQ 
 

 
 Q. What are the main benefits of the Kojic Acid Turmeric Eye Serum?
 It helps improve the appearance of dark circles, puffiness, dullness, and fine lines while providing lightweight hydration for smoother, more refreshed-looking eyes.
 

 
 Q. What are the key ingredients in this eye serum?
 The formula features Kojic Acid, Turmeric, and Vitamin C for uneven tone and radiance care, Caffeine and Retinol for puffiness and firmness care, and Hyaluronic Acid and Panthenol for hydration.
 

 
 Q. Does this eye serum help with dark circles?
 Yes. Kojic Acid, Turmeric, and Vitamin C help improve the appearance of dull, uneven-looking under-eye tone and dark circles for a more radiant, refreshed look.
 

 
 Q. Does it help with under-eye puffiness?
 Yes. Caffeine helps reduce the look of puffiness and tired-looking under eyes.
 

 
 Q. What does the cooling sensation do?
 The refreshing cooling sensation helps soothe tired-looking eyes and leaves the under-eye area feeling fresh and revitalized.
 

 
 Q. What is the texture like?
 It has a lightweight, skin-hugging gel texture that absorbs comfortably without feeling sticky or heavy, leaving the eye area smooth and hydrated.
 

 
 Q. How is this different from the PDRN Pink Peptide Eye Serum?
 The Kojic Acid Turmeric Eye Serum focuses on dark circles, puffiness, and refreshing radiance care with Kojic Acid, Turmeric, Vitamin C, and Caffeine. The PDRN Eye Serum focuses more on fine lines, elasticity, and uneven tone care with PDRN, Retinol, Peptide, and Niacinamide.

 FAQ 
 
 
 Q. Does the pink formula made with artificial colors?

 Q. When should I incorporate this into my skincare routine?

 Q. Won't the collagen mask prevent the skin from breathing?
 
 The wrapping mask is designed to wrap around the skin without causing discomfort during sleep, so you can use it without any worries.
